resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 2026 association page say abandoned in 1973; the 2023 association report says out of use since 1978. The story reports both and does not choose.
Firelookout.com alone dates a camp lookout to 1910 before the 1925 cupola; the register and the Montana History Portal begin with the 1925 cupola.
Elevations differ: 7,146 ft (register, 2026 page), 7,243 ft (firelookout.com), 7,257 ft (Montana History Portal). The record keeps the register figure of 2178.1 m.

Repair dates differ: partly restored in the 1990s (register, Montana History Portal); legs and shutter supports rebuilt in the late 1980s (firelookout.com); renovation completed 1983 (Forest Lookouts page).

notes_for_editor: Abandonment year conflicts (1973 vs 1978); both are stated in the story. Elevation differs across four sources; record kept. The record's 2016 assessed event is not supported by any source I read. The record's 2023 note mentions 'a few panes', which I did not find in the 2023 report text. Tower described as log (NHLR, 2026 page), pole (firelookout.com) and timber (Forest Lookouts page). The 1910 camp lookout appears only on firelookout.com. Access level 'restricted' is inferred from emergency-only use, not an official status. Register's 'Mt. Henry' 1973 text contains the typo 'n 1973' as printed.
